scope: 12 locally authored synthetic Draw.io tasks created after Stage E duplicate-run diagnostics and the long-label Development remediation. The cohort is unseen by the generation model but remains an internal validation cohort, not an externally held final holdout.
acceptancePolicy: Use only the sibling pre-run acceptance-policy-v2.json; neither Stage D nor Stage E post-output review may change this rubric.
reviewRequirement: Two named reviewers must approve every source/evidence/claim package before a model call.
stoppingRule: After reviewer approval and explicit user authorization, run this frozen cohort once. Do not tune prompts, model parameters, task data, sources, assertions, evaluator or policy after observing output.
